454.synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Hajime Nagumo is your average, everyday otaku. However, his simple life of pulling all-nighters and sleeping in school is suddenly turned upside down when he, along with the rest of his class, is summoned to a fantasy world! 
They’re treated like heroes and tasked with the duty of saving the human race from utter extinction.
 But what should have been any otaku’s wet dream quickly turns into Hajime’s nightmare? While the rest of his class are blessed with godlike powers, Hajime’s job, Synergist, only has a single transmutation skill. Ridiculed and bullied by his classmates for being weak, he soon finds himself in despair. 
Will he be able to survive in this dangerous world of monsters and demons with only a glorified blacksmith’s level of strength?

1222.synopsis:
After an unexpected and devastating loss at the Battle of Atropatene, the Crown Prince of Pars must gain new strength and make new allies to retake his lost kingdom. The 14-year-old Arslan has been sheltered for most of his life, but now must face the challenges of warfare, betrayal, politics and something even more sinister looming on the horizon.
With the help of a few loyal followers, Arslan quickly learns that nothing is ever as it seems on the surface. His own family history, the identity of the masked stranger trying to kill him, and the cause of increasingly strange supernatural events are all mysteries to be solved.
Set in a fictional representation of ancient Persia, this classic story (from Japanese author Dr. Yoshiki Tanaka) combines political intrigue, military tactics, and fantasy.

2502.synopsis:
“Before the end of his break, I’ll have to discipline brother until he can no longer leave me!”
Shrouded in the light of their noble birth since the day they were born, top military academy honour students—twin brothers Ling Qian and Ling Han have always coveted after the ownership of their older adoptive brother, Ling Wei.
During the intense competition between the twins, Ling Qian made the first move.
“I absolutely can’t let Ling Han, who’s returning with military privileges, take sole possession of brother!”
Ling Wei, full of soldierly bearings and pure as the sunlight, by his second brother’s cunning tricks, was coerced into becoming his younger brother’s s*xual object for discipline and sating his lust, constantly subjected to cruel and tender ravishments both mentally and physically.
But most embarrassingly, he grew from unbearably shameful resistance, to gradually being pulled deep down into the abyss of immoral pleasures.
Just as Ling Wei writhed under his second brother, crying and moaning from his restless thrusting, their third brother Ling Han was returning after successfully completing a trial of life and death, full of extreme jealousy ….

2758.synopsis: A noisy little family, a cheerful group of classmates, and a boy, born on the first year of the lunar calendar living a never changing life. Then one day he notices a girl in his class shrouded in mystery. Her name is Makina. However, the boy just can’t seem to bring himself to talk to Makina. Then one day, before the first lunar calendar month, another mysterious beauty appears. Her name is Rushia, and as she leans in as if she is going to kiss him, she tells him about a mysterious power hidden inside him called the “Snake Eyes.”

4806.synopsis:
Every male or female that entered the bar, all hoped to become the center of attention. However, Tang Xin Lian was the opposite. Undoubtedly receding to sit in a corner alone, dressed suitably but not sexily, yet she still managed to attract the gaze of Zhong Zhen Dong. Let’s not talk about the fact that she only ordered a glass of milk at the bar, she had a pair of clear and innocent big eyes that brought about mischief in others!
Against expectations, this little white rabbit had the courage to walk over with milk in hand, and opened her mouth in hopes of hiring him as her fake husband. Furthermore, it included food and housing, but not sleeping together. The only condition was to help her fend off a “bad peach!” (a bad relationship)
~Tsk tsk tsk~ (Sound of clicking one’s tongue). How can one survive without knowing the viciousness (dangers) of mankind? Just let him, this big, feral wolf, personally teach the dangers of playing with fire.
She said she wasn’t interested in men? It doesn’t matter, it’s okay as long as he’s interested in her!
She said she doesn’t want to marry? He doesn’t care about a person’s status, he’s satisfied to be able to love her everyday!
Her son is from a previous marriage? Even if she had 100 sons, it wouldn’t matter! Furthermore, this 8-year old little rascal was very useful; can tease, can play with, can act as a hostage.
She was completely in the palm of his hand. He watched the little white rabbit still not obediently submitting and returning under the wolf’s claws quietly as his dessert!

5318.synopsis: Gu Mingxi and Pang Qian were next-door neighbors, classmates, and deskmates. From year-to-year, even when the class seating was rearranged, they would still be deskmates. However, Gu Mingxi was different.

10694.synopsis:
In her past life, she had no one to rely on and died alone in jail.

“Break his legs! Fail his organs! A fake illness? I’ll make him sick completely!” A man said.

11462.synopsis:
One hundred thousand years ago, the once influential Church of Calamity was destroyed. Since then, necromancy had been lost to the ages.
One hundred thousand years later, a poor street urchin living in a mountain village, Roan, who dreams of becoming a great wizard, by some twist of fate, finds a seemingly ordinary ring. Coincidentally, this ring happened to hold a spirit that was one hundred thousand years old.
In a continent where magical combat runs wild, the mysterious, terrifying and powerful magic of necromancy returns. What kind of waves will it cause?
Now a necromancer, Roan chases the truth behind necromancy’s disappearance one hundred thousand years ago.

15302.synopsis:
An Luo’s life spiraled into chaos after a brutal accident left him reborn as the young master of a powerful business dynasty. Favored by his influential grandfather but nothing more than a pawn in his brothers’ vicious power games, he quickly realized that survival in this family wasn’t guaranteed.
But what truly rattled him wasn’t the cutthroat competition—it was the haunting intensity in his younger brother’s gaze. The emotions behind those eyes were unsettling, sharp, and far too complicated. Trapped between fear and confusion, An Luo found himself questioning whether he was doomed to endure this twisted cycle of so-called “brotherly love.”
His frustration boiled over as he brooded, his fists clenched and his jaw tight. The weight of it all—the stares, the unspoken words, the suffocating tension—felt unbearable. 
Was this his fate?
To be chained forever to this torment under the guise of family?
Then, as if summoned by his thoughts, a figure emerged from the shadows, smirking like they’d heard every word of his inner turmoil. An Luo stiffened, caught off guard, his defenses rising in an instant. 
Swallowing the sharp retort that nearly escaped, he forced himself to mutter quietly, “No… it’s nothing.”

16070.synopsis:

19910.synopsis:
In a thrilling tale of otherworldly dimensions, a young boy finds himself thrust into a dark and mysterious parallel world, inhabiting the body of his senior sister, Lily. On her very first day in this enigmatic realm, Lily encounters the mesmerizing night parade of a hundred ghosts, setting off a chain of events that will test her resilience and survival instincts.
Amidst the chaos of warriors and their disputes, Lily must navigate the treacherous landscape, seeking not only to survive but to carve out her own destiny. With unwavering determination, she sets out on a quest to forge a cursed sword, an extraordinary weapon that may hold the key to her survival and success in this chaotic world.
As she battles formidable adversaries and unravels the secrets of the parallel realm, Lily’s journey becomes an unparalleled adventure. Her transformation from a boy into a captivating young woman is just the beginning of her extraordinary odyssey. Boundaries blur and reality intertwines with the fantastical as Lily embraces her newfound identity, forging her own path in a world that defies imagination.
In this unimaginable otherworldly adventure, join Lily as she embarks on a quest of self-discovery, facing ghosts, warriors, and the unknown. Will she unravel the mysteries of this parallel world and emerge victorious? Prepare to be captivated by a tale where survival, courage, and the indomitable spirit of a lone girl intertwine to create an unforgettable journey.

20166.synopsis:
Before rebirth, Xia Man had been wondering, when did Qu Zhen begin to hate her?
Was it when she foolishly followed behind her and constantly talked while eating? Or when she would always clumsily break the gifts she was given? So she started hating her?
Did she think such a person was not worthy of being her friend at all? Doesn’t deserve the sunshine?
Right! Sunshine or whatever, it can only be her Qu Zhen!
Xia Man always felt that the friendship between the two was like Qu Zhen’s alms to herself, never equal.
Xia Man didn’t understand what Qu Zhen meant until she died.
“I thought I never missed it. Now I understand that I’ve never been right.”

After Xia Man was reborn, she only wanted one thing.
She wanted those who used her to hurt Qu Zhen to die rather than to live!

“To the person in search of a second story—become the hero that saves the common people from despair, defeat the demon king and his minions, or just settle for a casual life as a leisurely villager. You can become any kind of person you want in this world.

28870.synopsis:
Sixteen-year-old Luo Bing makes a playful prayer and ends up crossing time and space to land on Kansas Planet, right when Kansas Planet is experiencing the end of the world.  
Clueless about this alien world, Luo Bing is terrified. Fortunately, Noah City gives her sanctuary and she eventually gets a chance to explore this new world.
The end of the world is marked by extreme scarcity. Ubiquitous radiation has heavily limited the food, water and resources, and danger lies at every turn. As a result of this extreme environment, some humans have evolved and developed superpowers, while others have turned into monsters and even spirits. Humans who naturally possess an anti-radiation constitution are called radiationers. Most of the radiationers have unique superpowers, and they are referred to as metahumans.
With no clue on how to return to her own world, Luo Bing is stuck here and must survive against all odds. Armed with the combat skills she has learned from her dad and her newly developed superpowers, as well as help from the guys she has developed feelings for, can Luo Bing save this strange new world?

If she were to make the choice again, Ji Bai would never have let her two-faced sickly sister use her as a personal blood bank. She simply wanted to live her own life.
But in her previous life, Ji Bai ended up neglecting that intimidating young boy.
When she escaped the hospital in an anemic state with nowhere to go, she fainted in the streets. He brought her home, took care of her meticulously and cherished her.
For countless long nights, he would kiss the ugly scar on her spine where they drew blood from her.
Even after her death, he went mad and broke into the funeral to take her ice cold body.
Returning to when she was 16, Ji Bai seemed to not be afraid of him. When he stared at her from a dark and gloomy corner, Ji Bai looked back at him with a sweet smile.
“As long as you behave, I’ll be your good friend.”
Hearing her sincere warning, he looked down at her and laughed coldly——
“Who the hell wants to be your good friend?”
He just wanted to hold her in his arms.
**

She didn’t need a decent husband; she needed a man who would eventually be legally removed from her life. Once he filled out the divorce petition listing the names of the women he had affairs with, she could finally become a successful Ortega woman.

“I will not touch any woman but you. Until you give birth to our child, and even after that, regardless of any children we have, I will satisfy you, and you will satisfy me.”

Player B: “Wait, you want to main ‘Healer Assassin’???”
Player C: “First, you need to be [Cycle of Eternity] . Second, you need to be [Cycle of Eternity] .”
Player D: “Lastly, if you want to dominate both PvE and PvP, you need a healer partner named [Yin-Yang Harmony] bound to your soul.”
—
Violent DPS · Genius Operator · Healer-Assassin Shou [Cycle of Eternity] x Top Technical Stream · Healer Gong [Yin-Yang Harmony] 
Duo-healer domination system, original holographic VR setting inspired by real MMOs + custom worldbuilding, everything serves the plot.

107718.synopsis:
Qiu Shi held the prestigious position of overseeing the Four Seas, a beloved little koi princess doted on by her parents, a noblewoman of the Four Wastes with both name and status, and a fiancé so formidable he seemed peerless—her childhood betrothed.
Living carefreely until the age of thirty thousand, Qiu Shi rescued a severely injured black dragon from the depths of the ocean. The moment she laid eyes on him, her heart inexplicably raced.
Defying her parents’ objections and ignoring the gossip of outsiders, she took Cheng Yi into her courtyard, tending to him personally. For his sake, she even prepared to break off her engagement with the young patriarch of the demon clan—her arrogant, unruly childhood companion.
That very night, Qiu Shi had an eerily vivid dream.
She became the vicious female antagonist in a cliché xianxia romance novel. No matter how powerful her initial setup was, the author forcibly dumbed her down, making her suffer at every turn to pave the way for the female lead.
The male lead was none other than Cheng Yi, the one she had saved. According to the story, Qiu Shi fell for him at first sight, disregarding his lowly status, personally feeding him medicine, nursing him with devotion, and following him recklessly.
Yet in the end, Cheng Yi would be moved by the female lead’s kindness, ascending to godhood and wielding unparalleled power.
The story concluded with the male and female leads’ grand wedding, while Qiu Shi—the troublemaking villainess—would have her cultivation stripped away and be imprisoned in a desolate courtyard.
Imprisoned · Antagonist · Qiu Shi could not accept this: *This is utterly absurd.*
associated_names: Back before the villain's dark turn

108742.synopsis:
Ji Wuchang has been reborn, returning to the moment right before his duel with Xiao Fan!
And this time, he awakened the Sign-In and Copy System!
The system has only two functions: one is sign-in, and the other is copy!
There are rewards for signing in every day!
The copy function allows him to duplicate anything from his opponent—including cultivation techniques, combat skills, secret arts, lifespan, physique, pills, comprehension ability, and more!
In his previous life, all his suffering began because of Xiao Fan.
In this life, he will start by defeating Xiao Fan and open a brand new chapter!
When Ji Wuchang comes to claim a life, who dares to stop him?
In front of Ji Wuchang, all things turn to dust!
The young prodigies cry out in despair: “If Ji Wuchang already exists, why was I even born?!”
associated_names: 玄幻：无敌，从复制经验开始！

111302.synopsis:
After completing 999 quick-transmigration tasks, Xu Yao gloriously retired, becoming a cannon fodder female supporting character in the entertainment industry who missed out on a massive inheritance.
The original body was universally reviled in the entertainment circle, with scandals flying everywhere. In despair, she jumped from a high building, only to be found by her wealthy brother.
Xu Yao recalled the inheritance left to her in the book and decisively decided to pack her bags, exit the industry, and collect rent, inheriting hundreds of buildings.
After Xu Yao’s high-profile exit from the industry, netizens excitedly spread the news.
Haters sneered: “Xu Yao, you must be living a hard life after leaving the industry, right? I heard you’ve fallen so low that you’re doing live streams now?”
Xu Yao sighed: “It’s really tiring to do live streams every day while carrying a snake-skin bag to collect rent.”
Haters: Collect rent? What rent?
When a top star stirred up a scandal, reporters surrounded his doorstep, and Xu Yao appeared in front of the cameras.
Haters were furious: “You left the industry but still want to cling to the top star?!!”
Xu Yao opened her WeChat payment code and handed it to the top star: “Could you please pay me the rent you owe for half a year?”
Haters: ?!?
In the most-watched island retirement variety show, the female lead wanted to go out to take photos and called the landlord to sweet-talk her way into borrowing the luxurious yacht in the villa.
Xu Yao decisively refused.
Haters screamed: “Why does the voice of the island villa owner sound like Xu Yao’s??”
Xu Yao smiled: “Because all the villas on the island are mine.”
The IP blockbuster, praised for its beautiful scenery, was filmed in a private century-old mansion worth over a billion in the capital city.
Netizens intentionally stirred up trouble by asking on a certain platform: “No way, is this another property of Xu Yao?”
Highly upvoted answer: “It really is Xu Yao’s investment property.”
Netizens were dumbfounded: “Sister Yao is so rich??”
Gradually, netizens not only discovered that Xu Yao’s properties seemed to be worth a bit more than a billion, but she also became an internet sensation after leaving the industry!
*
At a dinner party, Ji Zhengqing, the mysterious heir of the Ji family in the capital, caught a glimpse of a small star who was blacklisted online.
Later, according to the will, Xu Yao not only inherited hundreds of buildings from the Xu family but also agreed to get engaged to Ji Zhengqing.
Friend: “Young Master Ji, your sister-in-law is secured!”
Ji Zhengqing: “Not necessarily.”
Relying on these hundreds of buildings, Xu Yao successfully made it onto the global rich list, and Ji Zhengqing realised that his only advantage seemed to be his status as her fiancé.
associated_names: Retiring From the Entertainment Circle to Collect Rent Everyday
继承百栋楼后我退圈收租

112326.synopsis: Fang Chen has just transmigrated to another world and discovers he has a death duel scheduled with a protagonist who was recently rejected in marriage. Trembling in fear, his system awakens, and he thinks a savior has arrived. However, the system’s first task is for Fang Chen to improve his cultivation, fully exert himself to awaken the protagonist’s potential, and then die in the duel. Faced with two options that both lead to death, Fang Chen decides to first give the protagonist cultivation methods and pills. To his astonishment, after giving them away, he immediately masters the very techniques he handed over. At that moment, Fang Chen’s eyes light up!
associated_names: 玄幻：叫你去送死，没让你无敌

115398.synopsis:
The benefactor asked me to take care of his youngest daughter who had entered the Warrior Academy, so I became a teacher there for three years.
There, I suffered terrible contempt and insults simply because I was a commoner.
That won’t happen anymore.
The benefactor’s youngest daughter has now graduated.
associated_names: 용사 아카데미 그만둔 교사지만 모험가 교육 담당으로 잘 먹고 잘 삽니다

125894.synopsis:
Ellie, a maid from a distant countryside.
She comes to the capital in search of work.
Momentarily dazzled by the splendid mansion and exceptional wages,
she ends up sharing a room with Diana, a suspiciously beautiful person.
“I hate sharing my private life with anyone.
So changing clothes, washing up, and such—let’s do those things separately.”
What a city snob!
But Ellie, who needs to support her siblings,
has no choice but to accept her demanding roommate’s requirements.
*
*
Daniel, who infiltrated as a “cross-dressing” maid for some purpose.
Suddenly, he has an unwanted roommate.
“Have you ever kissed someone?”
She’s somewhat careless and
“But Diana, you’re… really strong.”
Oblivious too, but
“I really like you, Diana!”
She’s a woman who sometimes lifts him up and drops him down.
Thanks to her, the path to achieving his goal keeps getting further away.
*
*
“It’s your fault.”
Daniel lowered his head.
His lips descended upon Ellie’s defenseless, parted lips.

130758.synopsis:
The “Mirage” server of Huaxia Online is as empty and desolate as its name suggests… or in gamer terms, a ghost server.
As veteran players leave and new players never arrive, the last stragglers gradually band together: power-leveling, dungeon-crawling, monster-slaying, and bullshitting their way through the game.
Every player clinging to this ghost server is a fallen angel. Eventually, these angels form a guild: the Ghost Server Legion.
And then… the ghost server merges with a god-tier server.
One-Line Summary: The rags-to-riches tale of a ghost server’s underdogs after merging with elite players.
associated_names: กองกำลังเซิร์ฟร้าง
